trade_setups.title: Pin / Mean-Reversion Frame
trade_setups.thesis: Heavy positive gamma near spot can dampen movement and favor range behavior. Delta is fragile, so expect weaker pinning and faster zone failures.
trade_setups.risk: Break and acceptance outside the pin zone can invalidate the range setup.
trade_setups.exact_trade: SPX 2026-09-21 Iron Condor: Buy 7620 Put / Sell 7630 Put / Sell 7655 Call / Buy 7665 Call (1-lot structure).

trade_setups.title: Upside Compression Toward Call Wall
trade_setups.thesis: Positive gamma above can attract price toward the next call concentration while compressing realized vol. Nearest delta pocket around 7650 also supports upside stickiness.
trade_setups.risk: Failure back below the reclaimed wall can trap upside continuation entries.
trade_setups.exact_trade: SPX 2026-09-21 Call Debit Spread: Buy 7800 Call / Sell 8100 Call (1-lot structure).

trade_setups.title: Downside Expansion Through Put Wall
trade_setups.thesis: Negative gamma below can open a faster move toward the next downside pocket. Negative aggregate delta can amplify downside instability if puts gain sensitivity into weakness.
trade_setups.risk: Quick reclaim above the broken put wall can trigger short-covering and whipsaw.
trade_setups.exact_trade: SPX 2026-09-21 Put Debit Spread: Buy 7500 Put / Sell 7450 Put (1-lot structure).
